definitions.explanation: Something of exceptionally high quality, especially food or drink. Conveys that something is so good it stands out as extraordinary.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絶品|ぜっぴん}だ。
⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絶品|ぜっぴん}だった。
examples.english: The sashimi made with local fish was exquisite.

examples.japanese: ⟦{口|くち}コミ→口コミ：17690_kuchikomi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まった→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧{絶品|ぜっぴん}⟦グルメ→グルメ：10845_gurume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to try the superb dish that spread by word of mouth.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used as a predicate: X⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絶品|ぜっぴん}だ (X is superb). Also used as a modifier: {絶品|ぜっぴん}⟦グルメ→グルメ：10845_gurume⟧ (superb cuisine), {絶品|ぜっぴん}⟦スイーツ→スイーツ：27370_suiitsu⟧ (exquisite sweets). Overwhelmingly used for food and drink in modern Japanese, though it can apply to other items of exceptional quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶品|ぜっぴん}⟦グルメ→グルメ：10845_gurume⟧: superb cuisine
- {絶品|ぜっぴん}⟦スイーツ→スイーツ：27370_suiitsu⟧: exquisite sweets
- {絶品|ぜっぴん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: exquisite flavor
- {絶品|ぜっぴん}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: outstanding dish
